articles.summary: Green Brick Partners, Inc. (NYSE: GRBK) (the “Company” or “Green Brick”), the third largest homebuilder in Dallas-Fort Worth, announced that it will release its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, after the market closes on October 28, 2026. Jim Brickman, Green Brick’s CEO, will host an earnings conference call to discuss its results at 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time on Thursday, October 29, 2026. The call will be webcast on the Company’s website Investors.greenbrickpartners.com.
